entries.description: Women's center in Orland, Maine running residential courses and retreats from spring to fall on 10 acres adjoining wild land, with housing, partial plumbing/electricity, camping, woods and a bio-dynamic garden. Welcomes new members/residents, workshop participants and guides, interns/apprentices, staff, private retreatants and artists in residence.
entries.raw_text: HARDSCRABBLE HILL CENTER Box 130-Castine Rd, Orland, ME 04472 (207)469-7112. From Spring to Fall our intensive residential courses and retreats for women expand the heart, challenge thinking, and offer practical tools and experience. We welcome: new members/residents, workshop participants, workshop guides, internships-apprentices, staff, private retreatants, artists in residence. We welcome all wild women, whatever stage or age on the feminist journey, creating new names as we go. We have: 10 acres of land adjoining several hundred wild, housing/permanent structures, plumbing/electricity in some buildings, camping space, woods, bio-dynamic garden, women living and workin' the land.
entries.notes: Type: place whose main purpose is 'intensive residential courses and retreats for women' (codebook example), so Retreat/Gathering Space. Land address from road address 'Box 130-Castine Rd'. Acreage 10; the 'several hundred wild' acres it adjoins are not its own and are left out. num_residents blank: 'women living and workin' the land' but no count. 'We welcome all wild women' before 1986 gives Lesbian women + Non-lesbian women. Workshops/education from courses, workshops, internships-apprentices. Bio-dynamic garden and artists in residence treated as passing mentions, not coded.

entries.land_location_as_stated: Our 30 acres is surrounded by 100's of acres of unused, undeveloped land at present
entries.description: Family of 2 lesbians and 2 girl children on 30 acres near Dexter, Maine, with trails for hiking and camping, housing, electricity, well and outhouse. No housing for visitors but campers welcome, with camping near the road for disabled lesbians. Welcomes girl children, boy children by invitation, non-lesbian women and dogs.
entries.raw_text: LINDA TISDALE/CAROL SHOREBORN RFD 2 Box 3085, Dexter, ME 04930 (207)924-5172. We are a small family of 2 lesbians, 2 girl children, 1 dog, 4 cats, 1 horse (soon to be more). We've cleared trails for hiking, picnics, camping, etc. Our 30 acres is surrounded by 100's of acres of unused, undeveloped land at present. We currently have no housing for other lesbian visitors but we welcome campers. Must be able to hike to campsite carry all needs in and out! Camping available near road for differently abled lesbians. We do not smoke, drink, use drugs. We welcome: girl children (boys by invitation only!), nonlesbian women, dogs. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 2 girl children, 30 acres of land, housing/permanent structures, electricity, well water, outhouse, camping space, woods, women living and workin' on the land.
entries.notes: No community name; listing headed by the two women's names, used as community_name and contact_name. Type: two-woman rule, 'small family of 2 lesbians'; taking campers does not change it. Land address from rural route 'RFD 2 Box 3085'. Acreage 30; the surrounding '100's of acres' are not theirs and are left out. num_residents 4: 2 lesbians + 2 girl children, 'women living and workin' on the land'. Boy children coded with condition 'boys by invitation only!'. Recovery/substance-free from 'We do not smoke, drink, use drugs.' Camping near the road for 'differently abled lesbians' noted as an accommodation, not coded as a Disabled women focus.

entries.description: Addition to Northwoods' earlier listing: offers retreat and healing space, mostly primitive camping at $2-5 a day, on 143 hilly acres in Alpine, New York, with poor accessibility, two swimming ponds and a sauna in progress. Work welcomed, chemicals discouraged.
entries.raw_text: NORTHWOODS RD 1 Box 156, Alpine, NY 14805. This is additional info to our listing in VI,2. We can offer retreat and healing space mostly in the form of primitive camping - $2 to $5 a day if you can. Our accessibility is unfortunately poor (143 acres almost all uphill.) We'll probably have a visitor kitchen so please bring your own food, the sauna is in progress and both ponds are fine for swimming. Work is welcomed. Chemicals are discouraged.
entries.notes: Not a listing: addition to the community's own earlier listing ('This is additional info to our listing in VI,2'), so not_a_listing with no type. Land address from rural route 'RD 1 Box 156'. Acreage 143. No groups named. Environmentalism/eco-friendly from 'Chemicals are discouraged.' 'Our accessibility is unfortunately poor' noted; not a Disabled women focus.

entries.description: One woman homesteader, farmer and carpenter on a 20-acre farm near Dillsburg, Pennsylvania, with beef and milk cows, chickens, bees, fruit trees, garden, house, barn, woods, farmland and pasture. Short visits of 2-3 days with work exchange; non-lesbian women welcome. No drugs, cigarettes, pets or guns.
entries.raw_text: ONEIDA FARM RD 5, Dillsburg, PA 17019 (717)432-2157. (Between Harrisburg and Gettysburg.) I am a homesteader/farmer/carpenter on 20 acres with cows (beef and milk), chickens, bees, fruit trees, garden I am not a separatist and cannot accomodate flag-waving, breast-baring sisters. Visits (limited to 2-3 days) require work exchange. No drugs, cigarettes, pets, guns. Visitors are expected to bring own food, etc. Non-lesbian women welcome. I prefer that you telephone so that we get to know each other before we set up a visit. I have a house, barn, electricity, woods, farmland, pasture.
entries.notes: Type: one woman, 'I am a homesteader/farmer/carpenter on 20 acres', so Private/Individual Land; work-exchange visitors do not change it. num_residents 1: she describes herself as on the land. Land address from rural route 'RD 5'. Lesbian women coded as questionnaire-directory listing; Non-lesbian women named ('Non-lesbian women welcome'). Farming/self-sufficiency from homesteading with 'cows (beef and milk), chickens, bees, fruit trees, garden'. Recovery/substance-free from 'No drugs, cigarettes, pets, guns.' Rejects separatism ('I am not a separatist'); not coded.

entries.description: New women's community and retreat center 35 miles north of Baltimore, Maryland, on 35 acres of woods, meadow and stream held in a land trust, with 6 buildings, organic gardens, bees, wood and solar heat, electricity/plumbing, camping and indoor space. 4 lesbians with feminist and political ties to the Baltimore women's community; developing the retreat center (for up to 50) as a business. Welcomes visitors, new members, all women and children.
entries.raw_text: HEATHCOTE WOMENS COMMUNITY 21300 Heathcote Rd, Freeland, MD 21053 (301)343-1070. We are a new wom'ns community/retreat center, 35 miles north of Baltimore. We have/are: 4 lesbians with a feminist perspective, support for political involvement, strong ties with Baltimore wom'ns community, 35 acres of woods, meadow, stream in a land trust, 6 buildings, organic gardens, bees, wood and solar heat, electricity/plumbing, camping and indoor space. We are developing the retreat center (facilities for up to 50) as a business to support the place and members. Local jobs are possible with wom'n landscaping company, wom'ns printing shop. Long and short term commitment. We welcome: visitors, new members, all women of all colours and persuasions, girl and boy children. It's a wonderful place and we want to share it!
entries.notes: Type: land is 'in a land trust', so Land Trust, though it also calls itself 'community/retreat center'. Land address from road address '21300 Heathcote Rd'. num_residents blank: 'We have/are: 4 lesbians' but the listing does not state they live on the land. 'all women of all colours and persuasions' before 1986 gives Lesbian women + Non-lesbian women; 'girl and boy children' gives Girl and Boy children. Inclusive 'all colours' noted, not coded as Women of color. Organic gardens, bees, and 'wood and solar heat' are 'We have/are' items, not coded as Farming or Environmentalism. 'facilities' printed with an overstruck letter; read as 'facilities'.

entries.community_name: WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET
entries.land_location_as_stated: Between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA.
entries.description: Two lesbian musicians on 20 acres between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA, where they built a passive solar shell; they live there full time and work off the land part time, aiming for small-scale farming and farm animals. Welcome non-lesbian women, children with supervision, men, small female dogs, and especially non-competitive musicians and singers. No drugs, tobacco or heavy drinkers.
entries.raw_text: WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET c/o Nan and Ruth, PO Box 63, Unger, WV 25447 (304)258-5079. (Between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA.) We own 20 acres on which we built a passive solar shell this summer with the help of friends. We have to work away from the land at this point, but one of us is trying to find local work to be able to be more in touch with the land (small-scale farming and a few farm animals are a short-range goal). We are musicians & especially welcome non-competitive musicians and singers. We welcome: non-lesbian wimmin, girl & boy children (parental supervision a must), males, medium to small dogs (females only, please). Bring food to share. No drugs, tobacco, or heavy drinkers. We have/are: 2 lesbians, 20 acres, housing & permanent structures, electricity, camping space, woods, farmland, a male dog (does not get along with other male dogs), wimmin living (full time) and working (part time) on the land.
entries.notes: Community name is the printed phrase 'WE DON'T HAVE A NAME YET'. Type: two-woman rule, 'We have/are: 2 lesbians', couple who 'own 20 acres', so Private/Individual Land. num_residents 2: 'wimmin living (full time)... on the land'. PO box, so land street/zip blank; no land town named. land_state WV from mailing state; the land is placed 'Between Berkeley Springs, WV and Winchester, VA.' 'males' with no orientation gives Gay men + Non-gay men; children need 'parental supervision a must'. Non-lesbian women named. Recovery/substance-free from 'No drugs, tobacco, or heavy drinkers.' Farming/self-sufficiency from 'small-scale farming and a few farm animals are a short-range goal'. Archives/cultural work from 'We are musicians & especially welcome non-competitive musicians and singers.' Passive solar shell noted, not coded as Environmentalism.

entries.description: 3-5 women on 55 acres in hilly southeastern Ohio, with a house, barn, a second house under construction, animals, gardens, woods, pond, camping and farmland; women live and work on and off the land. Welcomes women and children for stays of up to a week with food and work exchange.
entries.raw_text: MOON RIDGE Rt 1 Box 240, Guysville, OH 45735. We are 3-5 wimmin on 55 acres in hilly southeastern Ohio. We have a house with electricity and a barn and another house under construction. We have dogs, cats, goats, gardens, woods, pond, camping space, farmland, wimmin living and working on and off the land. We welcome wimmin and children to stay up to a week for help with food and work exchange (house remodeling - house building - daily survival chores).
entries.notes: Type: 'We are 3-5 wimmin' living on the land, so Intentional Community/Cooperative. num_residents 3, smaller of range '3-5'. Land address from rural route 'Rt 1 Box 240'. 'We welcome wimmin and children' before 1986 gives Lesbian women + Non-lesbian women + Girl and Boy children. Goats and gardens treated as passing, not coded as Farming.
